modules.name: Achievement board side A
modules.note: Use side A for any game with a first-time player.

steps.text: Shuffle the Sharks & Reefs fish and starter fish into their decks; use the new achievement board and add its achievement tiles
All egg/young and school tokens in the general supply
Coral tokens in the general supply
Shuffle the {n} starter fish (gray corners) facedown near the supply
Shuffle the fish deck facedown beside them
Achievement board near the supply, side A up
Achievement board side B: 1 random tile each for weeks 1, 2 and 3, week lines matching the board
steps.note: Side B adds a 3-point bonus for the week's top scorer

steps.text: Each player: an ocean mat and the {n} divers of one color
Either side of any coral reef overlay over your twilight zone; take a player aid
1 egg on each of the 2 starting egg slots and 1 young on the starting young slot
Take {n} random starter fish, then draw 3 fish; lay them faceup beside your mat as your hand
Set up as for 2 players; side B bonuses count only at difficulty 5
Pick a color for Nautoma and give her those divers, 2 eggs and 1 young
Shuffle the decision cards; set 1 aside unseen, the rest is the decision deck
3 Nautoma achievement cards by the board, calm or stormy side up for your difficulty
{n} turns per week, 4 weeks
A dive site never holds more than 6 coral
Random first player takes the first-player token
You take the first turn every week
Each turn: place a diver to play a fish or to dive
